subject: general
question: What is the full form of 'PARIVESH', a single window integrated system for environment, forest, wildlife and CRZ clearances launched in August 2018?

options.text: Pradhanmantri Advanced and Responsive facilitation by Interactive, Virtuous and Environmental single-window Hub
Programmable Active and Responsive facilitation by Interactive, Virtuous and Environmental single-window Hub
Performance based Active and Responsive facilitation by Interactive, virtuous and Environmental single-window Hub
Pro-Active and Responsive facilitation by Interactive, Virtuous and Environmental single-window Hub

solution:
The correct answer is __**Pro-Active and Responsive facilitation by Interactive, Virtuous and Environmental single-window Hub**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PARIVESH** stands for **Pro-Active and Responsive facilitation by Interactive, Virtuous and Environmental single-window Hub**.
 
• It was launched in **August 2018** as a **single window integrated system** for obtaining various environmental, forest, wildlife, and CRZ (Coastal Regulation Zone) clearances.
 
• The system aims to streamline the process of granting clearances to projects, ensuring efficiency and transparency.
 
• It integrates various stages of environmental clearance processes, making it easier for project proponents to track their applications.
 
• PARIVESH enhances the ease of doing business by providing a platform for single-window clearance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Environmental clearances** are essential for ensuring that projects comply with environmental regulations and do not harm the ecosystem.
 
• The system is part of the government's efforts to promote **ease of doing business** and ensure sustainable development.
 
• PARIVESH is also integrated with the **Geographic Information System (GIS)** to provide spatial analysis and decision support.
 
• The initiative reflects the government's commitment to **improving environmental governance** and facilitating responsible project development.
 
• The system helps in reducing the time taken for granting clearances and enhances **transparency and accountability**.
